rule: every frontier point rerun at three seeds (its own, 101, 102) in final mode (launch.py --direction scorer --final: CW_FINAL=1, every checkpoint and start_bpb scored on the sealed final set, nothing ingested), longest first from 08:00Z on vy-nebius-1/-3, each seed started only if it ends by 15:00Z; a point left without its three seeds is labelled 'single seed: a rerun doesn't fit before the nodes end'
front_door: the integrator's finals job launches every finals rerun at its slot time: per node, while fewer than 2 of its reruns wait for a GPU, the next in this order (v3 longest first, the pilot last), with its launch command (--node is the node that frees first), from the overlay commit (the harness with the original's islands/); a rerun that exits 75 is relaunched, a seed already running or done is skipped, and each start is a STARTED line on this board. Lanes only collect (launch.py START --collect RUN --final --direction scorer) and post results

slots.rule: the coordinator's 06:25Z ruling: from 08:00Z the finals take every GPU that frees ahead of any queued search run; a search run that can't end by 15:00Z, or serves no frontier cell, is cancelled by its owner (research cancel RUN --reason ... --by LANE) when its slot is needed
